messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Reinstalling R - car library for regression will not install - does this affect lavaan functioning
parts:
On 01/27/2017 06:56 PM, R McLaren wrote:
> Hi
>
> I had to do a reinstall of R and RCommander, and the car package won't
> install. Are there implications for lavaan, sem? Is there a resolution
> path possible?

Not directly, as lavaan does not depend on the car package. lavaan does
depend on other packages, and they should be installed first (in
particular: mnormt, pbivnorm and quadprog).

Yves.

messages.subject: Re: Reinstalling R - car library for regression will not install - does this affect lavaan functioning
parts:
On 01/28/2017 09:12 PM, R MacLaren wrote:
> Hi Yves and thanks for the reply. So, to accomplish the task of
> installing mnormt, pbivnorm, and quadprog, would you have a link to a
> procedure?

install.packages("mnormt")
install.packages("pbivnorm")
install.packages("quadprog")

If you get errors during the installation of these packages, some
essential parts are missing on your system. But the error messages
should point to the parts that missing.

Yves.
